mutations.label: an experimental pack is mounted whether or not it was asked for
the product's coverage tables count an experimental pack
a name nobody publishes is skipped instead of refused, and the operator serves without the pack they asked for
mutations.find: return nil, fmt.Errorf("FEINT_EXPERIMENTAL_PACKS: no experimental pack %q (there is %s)", name, strings.Join(known, ", "))

note: The README, `feint status` and the page count what is mounted by default. An experimental pack is mounted only on request, so letting its coverage artefact reach those tables would make `feint docs --check` pass or fail with the shell it ran in, which is the property TestTheGatesVerdictDoesNotDependOnTheEnvironment exists to hold. The first mutation is the opposite failure: the pack leaks into the default mount and every default run answers a CloudStack nobody asked for.
